body.name: Second-order marked weak-overlap class
body.construction: \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{RV}}=\{P:(O_i)_{i=1}^n\text{ obey independent identical sampling, causal consistency, conditional exchangeability, bounded outcomes, one-sided support, }\kappa\in[\kappa_-,\kappa_+],\text{ the second-order lower-tail inequality, joint boundary-mark convergence, and residual separation}\}\) for every triangular index \(n\geq1\).
